requirement: Team card: the start screen's Team card draws up to three other members' faces and the seat count, and one account wears the same face at /auth/me, /api/team and the comment doors

oracle.invariant: The build check prints a count >= 1. FACE_ME is an object; MY_SEAT.initial === FACE_ME.initial and MY_SEAT.color === FACE_ME.color (one account, one face, at two doors). Every comment author compared (MATCHED rows) and every person of /comments/people match their seat's initial and color. FACES.length === Math.min(3, OTHERS.length) and FACES[i].text === OTHERS[i].initial and FACES[i].background === hexToRgb(OTHERS[i].color) for every i (the faces are the OTHER members, the viewer's own face is not among them). Every face has width 20 (+-1). TEAM_COUNT === String(N_VALID) (seats counted directly: active plus pending invitations, no join requests, no revoked, no declined, no +1). When OTHERS.length === 0, PEOPLE_TEXT is the 'only you' wording and no face is drawn; otherwise PEOPLE_TEXT ends with TEAM_COUNT. No page error, console.error or failed request on the page (chrome-watch --errors --page <KEY> after the load).
oracle.productSourceGap: no deterministic run, so no code to follow; owner layer api, needs stand, seat:owner

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
